newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks up after Dow rise, Ibex eyes 7,200.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks up after Dow rise, Ibex eyes 7,200.

text.p: MADRID, July 17 (Reuter) 0830 GMT - Madrid share prices were higher on Thursday, helped by a strong Dow Jones gain to above 8,000, dealers said.

The Ibex may test the 7,200 level, but this could prove hard to consolidate unless Wall St permits, they added. * General index up 3.43 points, 0.55 percent, to 628.95 * Ibex up 47.31 points, 0.66 percent, to 7,183.44 * BBV up 110 pesetas to 13,450, after unconfirmed press reports of a 23 percent gain in net profit in the first half, and ahead of its three for one share split. Santander recoups some ground, up 15 pesetas to 4,665.
"We're starting to see the effects of the futures expiry, but I have the impression it may be hard to stay above the 7,200 mark," said a dealer at a foreign brokerage.

Repsol was up 50 pesetas to 6,620, having broken the key 6,600 level. "There's a bit of offer further up, but Repsol at the moment is on everyone's buy list simply because it's underperformed," he added.
Supermarkets were again strong, with Pryca up 55 pesetas to 3,330 and Continente adding 110 pesetas to 3,560 after a put through order.
